meta.title: Provider group fold
meta.description: Makes the provider groups in DSH's built-in model menu collapsible — it does not build a second picker, it adds the one action the built-in menu lacks. Only the provider holding your current model starts expanded; every other provider folds away while still showing its model count, so a profile with a dozen providers no longer opens a wall of rows. Click any provider heading to expand or fold it, manual state is remembered while the page is open, an active search expands every group so matches are never hidden, and Tab plus Enter or Space toggles from the keyboard. The key difference: this plugin registers no slots and replaces no component, so the Agent Teams switch, provider badges and price hints from other plugins keep working unchanged, and uninstalling restores the menu immediately. The built-in menu already groups models and already has a search field; folding is the only thing missing, so that is all this adds. Known limitation: it is a DOM-level enhancement, so a future DSH release that renames the group markup makes it stop folding silently (it never breaks the menu).
